programme.title: 西拉沐淪
programme.desc: 西拉沐淪河發源於內蒙古高原的渾善達克沙地腹地，在赤峰境內奔流407千米後，匯入西遼河，最終注入渤海，是中國北方重要的河流之一西拉沐淪河流域作為內蒙古東部重要的水源涵養地，維持著周邊草原沙地濕地的生態平衡同時，流域內棲息著多種候鳥（如丹頂鶴白枕鶴）魚類（如瓦氏雅羅魚）及珍稀植物，是東亞澳大利西亞候鳥遷徙通道的重要組成部分，蜿蜒流淌的高原長河，孕育著豐富的野生動物種群和多樣的植被類型，使西拉沐淪河流域成為了中國北方的生物基因庫由中央廣播電視總台推出的西拉沐淪是中國首部北疆河流生態科學紀錄片全片共 4集，每集25分鐘深入內蒙古高原渾善達克沙地腹地，透過地質動物植物與環境依存關係，全方位展現西拉沐淪河流域（赤峰一帶）的壯麗自然景觀與豐富物種本節目由ampamplt赤峰市融媒體中心ampampgt贈播

programme.desc: 該劇由劉飚執導，劉承林米卓清領銜主演，講述1918年毛澤東從湖南第一師範畢業到1921年參加黨的一大所歷經的心路歷程這期間中國發生了巨大的變化，新文化運動掀起西學東漸的風潮，馬克思主義的曙光第一次照進中國，五四運動高舉起自由與民主的旗幟，軍閥混戰的硝煙加重了中國人民的苦難在這風雲際會的歷史舞台上，各方勢力風起雲湧，詭異的時局迷霧重重，國家和民族的命運如同蕭瑟寒風中的一葉扁舟，生死存亡只在一瞬這幾年間，毛澤東在國家民族危難之際，胸懷大志堅韌不拔尋找救國救民道路，從一個青年學子逐漸成長為堅定的馬克思主義者該劇通過毛澤東北上尋求真理組織青年學生赴法勤工儉學領導湖南驅張運動創辦湘江評論開展學運工運組建湖南共產主義小組等事件，記述了毛澤東如何在紛繁雜亂的眾多主義中尋找到馬克思主義並為之奮鬥一生的感人故事

programme.title: 鯤鵬擊浪
programme.desc: 該劇由劉飚執導，劉承林米卓清領銜主演，講述1918年毛澤東從湖南第一師範畢業到1921年參加黨的一大所歷經的心路歷程這期間中國發生了巨大的變化，新文化運動掀起西學東漸的風潮，馬克思主義的曙光第一次照進中國，五四運動高舉起自由與民主的旗幟，軍閥混戰的硝煙加重了中國人民的苦難在這風雲際會的歷史舞台上，各方勢力風起雲湧，詭異的時局迷霧重重，國家和民族的命運如同蕭瑟寒風中的一葉扁舟，生死存亡只在一瞬這幾年間，毛澤東在國家民族危難之際，胸懷大志堅韌不拔尋找救國救民道路，從一個青年學子逐漸成長為堅定的馬克思主義者該劇通過毛澤東北上尋求真理組織青年學生赴法勤工儉學領導湖南驅張運動創辦湘江評論開展學運工運組建湖南共產主義小組等事件，記述了毛澤東如何在紛繁雜亂的眾多主義中尋找到馬克思主義並為之奮鬥一生的感人故事

programme.title: 如果奔跑是我的人生
programme.desc: 劇集改編自紀靜蓉的小說如果奔跑是我的宿命，由鍾楚曦楊超越許娣陳小藝侯雯元領銜主演 該劇透過一場車禍，講述了兩個家庭如何在人生的逆境中展現出不同的生活態度和勇氣ampampampltbrampampampgt一次喜慶的壽宴後，一場意外的車禍對趙秀麗（陳小藝飾）和趙秀芳（許娣飾）的家庭造成了破壞性的打擊趙秀麗的兒子是一名成績優異的高中生，但在這場事故中不幸喪生，大女兒陳若華（楊超越飾）逃過一劫；而趙秀芳的女兒程安心（鍾楚曦飾）是一位年輕的舞蹈教師，也在這次事故中重傷失去了雙腿陳若華為了幫助母親趙秀麗從悲痛中恢復過來，將她帶到了自己的學生宿舍然而，陳若華在照顧心碎的母親和處理與周凱澤（王宥鈞飾）的戀情之間，感到極大的壓力另一方面，趙秀芳為了振奮失望的女兒程安心和逃避現實的女婿秦峰（宋洋飾），決定開始之前從未成功過的減肥隨著時間的推移，陳若華在與母親的關係中逐漸找回平衡，解開了母女之間的矛盾趙秀芳也最終成功地減掉了體重，幫助程安心重新勇敢面對生活

programme.title: 四川非遺100 - 第五季
programme.desc: 四川非遺100第五季是一部具有深刻文化內涵和藝術價值的紀錄片它通過精湛的視聽呈現生動的人物故事深入的文化溯源以及對時代發展的積極回應，全方位地展示四川非遺的獨特魅力和傳承價值它不僅是對四川非遺的一次深情禮贊，更是對所有非遺傳承人的致敬，也為觀眾提供一次了解非遺感受文化魅力的難得機會

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.desc: 李浚赫化身金家小兒子 婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 浪漫速成鄭敬淏 愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人復仇心的驅使下，他成為Gold Partners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事

programme.title: 男朋友

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 李昇基韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子 高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星

programme.desc: 浪漫速成鄭敬淏 愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人復仇心的驅使下，他成為Gold Partners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 李昇基韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子 高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 韓版羅馬假期 霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍 出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 李浚赫化身金家小兒子 婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 發現大灣區 第183集
programme.desc: 發現大灣區: 現今越來越多目光聚焦粵港澳大灣區, 尋找發展機遇與空間發現大灣區以鳳凰記者親身走訪大灣區92城市的形式, 運用雜誌式專題片手法, 深度報道灣區內的地標人物及熱點, 引領觀眾全方位地體驗感受大灣區的繁榮與創新, 機遇與煙火氣, 一同發現灣區內那些鮮為人知的成功故事

programme.title: 有報天天讀

programme.title: 鳳凰焦點新聞 1800

programme.title: 新聞今日談

programme.title: 總編輯時間

programme.title: 鳳凰大視野

programme.title: 鳳凰衝擊播 第703集

The Architecture the Railways Built
programme.desc: Tim Dunn visits the Ffestiniog railway in north Wales, originally built to transport slate from mountain to coast and learns about Amsterdam Centraal, which was controversially built across the waterfront

programme.title: The Flying Gardener
programme.desc: Chris Beardshaw visits Dumfries and Galloway to learn about the Scottish plant hunters who travelled the globe to find new species in Essex

programme.title: To the Manor Born
programme.desc: Audrey moves out of Grantleigh Manor, and Richard and his mother move in, disappointing the former resident with their new ways. Comedy, starring Penelope Keith and Peter Bowles

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Irrepressible snob Hyacinth concocts an elaborate plan to rescue Richard from social obscurity by turning him into an executive. His first stop is the local golf club, but he proves far from enthusiastic. Comedy, starring Patricia Routledge and Clive Swift

programme.title: Ardal OHanlon: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: The actor explores some of the most important archaeological finds in Irelands history, revealing how many have been used as an important tool for nation-building on both sides of the border. Speaking to world-renowned experts, he unravels a forgotten time period, when a team of Americans from Harvard University, a Nazi archaeologist from Austria, and a Welsh geography professor dug up ancient sites across the country. Their pioneering work answered questions about the Celts, and what it means to be Irish

programme.title: Kamikaze: An Untold History
programme.desc: On the Pacific front, towards the end of the Second World War, Japans imperial armed forces launched kamikaze attacks - suicide missions by aircraft laden with bombs. Close to 4,000 Japanese airmen died, and nearly 7,000 Allied military personnel were killed, and thousands more were injured by the attacks. How could this happen? Utilising 15 years worth of extensive interviews with US and Japanese veterans, Takayuki Oshimas film delves into the mechanism of how a crazed madness swept through an entire nation

programme.title: The Sky at Night
programme.desc: Professor Brian Cox joins the team to explore the mysteries of black holes in light of the James Webb Space Telescopes most exciting new observations, which has upended everything scientists thought they knew about black holes and the evolution of the universe itself

programme.title: Meaban is Moo
programme.desc: The stars are twinkling outside and Linda tasks Meaban and Moo with finding three star-shaped items. Their hut is full of junk so they need to have a good rummage

programme.desc: The friends are painting all sorts of things, but Neep wont take part. Soon everyone joins in with Neep instead and need to think of something clever to help them with their spots

programme.desc: Dave orders a water pistol with his birthday money, but is sent a unicorn toy instead. Will it bring joy and sparkle into his grumpy world?

programme.title: Str
programme.desc: The CBBC Alba presenters embark on another challenge, but it remains to be seen who will emerge victorious as they are joined by Alexa

programme.title: A Chil
programme.desc: Choirstaidh looks at an artist that inspires her, this time its Andy Warhol

programme.title: Dubhlain DIY Instructions Not Included
programme.desc: Derek Pluto Murray, head judge Iain Spanish MacKay and guest judge Erica MacPherson - set two upcycling-themed challenges to the next three couples to test their DIY skills. As always with this contest instructions are not included, so they need to improvise and keep their heads as they try to work out how best to tackle the task in hand and create their own DIY masterpieces as a team

programme.title: An L News
programme.desc: Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA

programme.title: Grradh Phdruig
programme.desc: It is autumn and the growing season has come to an end. To prepare for next year, Peter MacQueen saves the seeds from his tomatoes, so theyll be ready to replant again

programme.title: Hebridean Baker - Nordic Islands
programme.desc: Coinneach MacLeod journeys through the culinary and cultural landscapes of the Nordic region. On Denmarks Bornholm, he visits the Sol over Gudhjem food festival, helps make a rather unusual pastry and collects honey to make a local liqueur

programme.title: Rrachd Foraging
programme.desc: Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke forage natures bounty. On the shore they seek seaweeds - including pepper dulse that can be dried for an umami addition, and lasagne with kelp instead of pasta. Mary Ann has some fun catching spooties or razor clams on a beach close to home. She also recalls how to make carrageen pudding for the final episodes feast

programme.title: Miann na Maighdinn-mara Mermaid Tales
programme.desc: Kate MacLeod travels to Heisker, west of North Uist. She learns about the history of Bonnie Prince Charlie and follows in his footsteps, visiting a place called Rossinish, and she finds out more about a real mermaid that spotted swimming and later came ashore dead at Culla Bay. She also tries some carageen, in the form of a traditional dessert

programme.title: Faodail: Found
programme.desc: The Faodail Film Archive celebrates lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s to the 1980s in the Outer Hebrides, preserving the archive for future generations. The Cinema Sgre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands, showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online, and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gidhealtachd for contemporary audiences

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: Its harvest time for Andy and Jo in Fife as they finally reap what they have down - and after a challenging year it remains to be seen what the wet weather might have cost them. Nick and Holly diversify with a new cattle venture in Dumfries, and the Bakers on Papa Westray take delivery of a milking cow and calf to add to their ever-growing family

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Brian Cunninghams beginners guide to vegetable growing started in April, and now its time to reap the rewards as he starts to harvest from the veg plot. Calum Clunie starts the sowing cycle again in his family sized plot as he sows for winter crops

programme.title: Paramedics on Scene
programme.desc: In Glasgow, Paul and Ryan of the Special Operations Response Team are called to a siege in a flat, where a man has barricaded himself inside and is threatening to harm himself. Meanwhile, Aberdeen-based crewmates Kirsty and Bruce are called to see Rebecca, who has suffered a severe anaphylactic attack, but she shows little sign of improvement after several doses of adrenaline, prompting a rapid journey on blue-lights to Aberdeen Royal Infirmary

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day

programme.title: My Kind of Town
programme.desc: Ian Hamilton and his dog Major head to Cupar in Fife, a traditional market town that now has ambitions to be a digital hub. Ian gets the chance to practise his swing on the Kingarrock Hickory golf course and samples some tasty morsels at the farmers market

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: The autumn sales are over and preparations are being made for winter. In Newtonmore in Cairngorms National Park, Robert MacKenzie needs to gather in all his cows back down to the croft for pregnancy testing, while on North Uist, the MacDonalds are harvesting potatoes grown in the sandy machair soil unique to the west of Scotland

programme.title: Murder Trial: Death of a Dog Walker
programme.desc: Part one of two. Former gamekeeper David Campbell stands accused of the premeditated murder of Brian Low, a 65-year-old groundsman on the same estate where they both worked. With the site of the murder exposed to the elements for days, police are unable to forensically link anyone to the deceased, so the prosecution build a case against the accused around smaller, individual strands of circumstantial evidence, while working to convince the jury that hes guilty beyond reasonable doubt

programme.title: David Wilsons Crime Files
programme.desc: The criminologist discusses the use of forensic science in crime detection, looking at its 19th-century origins and more recent use in unresolved murder cases that are decades old

programme.title: Scotcast
programme.desc: Discussion on Scotlands biggest news stories, with Martin Geissler, Laura Miller and Natalie Higgins

programme.title: Icons of Football
programme.desc: A profile of former Celtic, Barcelona and Sweden striker Henrik Larsson, who reflects on his upbringing in the city of Helsingborg and early promise at Hgaborg and Helsingborgs, and his difficult years at Feyenoord, where game time and confidence wavered. The programme charts his transformation at Celtic, where he became the defining player of an era, before his story as a player culminated in Spain, where he joined Barcelona and played a decisive role in their 2006 Champions League triumph. With contributions by Martin ONeill, Chris Sutton, Johan Mjllby, Paul Lambert and Regi Blinker

programme.title: The Catch Up
programme.desc: A round-up of the days news

programme.title: Spud
programme.desc: Very average woman Spud cooks, cleans, serves and cares for her father. The only problem is she does it all rather badly - and half-heartedly. A woman who is never seen, unattractive and ignored, she does not feel bad about herself. However, when her father dies, she starts to realise she may have to come out from the shadow and be seen. Comedy drama, written by and starring Siobhn McSweeney

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: The gun-toting treasure seeker is thrown into a furious battle with a mysterious secret society as she races against time to locate the missing pieces of a legendary artefact that grants the owner the ability to control time. Action adventure based on the video games, starring Angelina Jolie, Daniel Craig, Leslie Phillips, Iain Glen, Chris Barrie and Jon Voight

programme.title: RuPauls Drag Race UK: Meet the Queens
programme.desc: RuPaul introduces the 12 queens competing for the coveted title of the UKs next drag race superstar

programme.title: Bridget Joness Diary
programme.desc: A single woman begins a new year with resolutions to find love, quit her bad habits and take a step up the career ladder. Her plans crumble as she tries to deal with her mothers infidelity, get over a passionate fling with her boss and come to terms with her feelings for an uptight lawyer. Romantic comedy based on Helen Fieldings novel, starring Renee Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Colin Firth

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: The disaster-prone journalist seems to have finally found the perfect boyfriend. However, when the couple start to squabble over their personal habits, she decides to decamp for a while to Thailand and write a travelogue. Unfortunately, she has reckoned without the reappearance of a duplicitous old flame - and a spell behind bars in a Thai prison. Romantic comedy sequel, with Renee Zellweger, Colin Firth, Hugh Grant, Jim Broadbent and Gemma Jones

programme.title: This Is BBC Two
programme.desc: Preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two

programme.title: Bargain Hunt: 20 Years of The One Show
programme.desc: Danny Sebastian hosts a special episode celebrating 20 years of the One Show, with Angellica Bell and JB Gill taking on Kevin Duala and Hannah Stitfall at an antiques fair in Builth Wells, Powys, assisted by experts Kate Bliss and Philip Serrell. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 2
programme.desc: Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican whos swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence. Follow vet Tim, who aids a surly koala with an eye infection, and watch a lumpy python give newbie Ruby a load of trouble.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 2
programme.desc: Shadow vet Bec, who patches up dog-bitten koala Rachel, and new vets Ruby and Kerryn, who soothe a pack of itchy possums. Free a pair of kookaburras trapped in a wall with rescue officer Dani and watch vet Tims squirrel glider knee surgery.

programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution Season 1
programme.desc: Some of the most interesting adaptations in the animal world are completely invisible. Study these hidden, internal alterations to see how different animals have evolved to survive in amazing and unseen ways.

programme.title: My Best Friends An Animal Season 2
programme.desc: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

programme.title: My Best Friends An Animal Season 2
programme.desc: Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

programme.title: Africas Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: To the lion, the buffalo is not only a satisfying dinner but also dangerous. Track a herd of 300 buffalo along with the Mwamba pride, who must act quickly and carefully if they are to take down their prey.

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.title: 破地狱The Last Dance

programme.title: 长津湖The Battle at Lake Changjin

programme.title: 红豆Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: 张家经营着位于九龙城的中式甜品店，然而母亲突发中风，令一家人陷入剧变女儿为了维持甜品店的生意，不得不放弃成为空姐的梦想，却在过程中与父亲产生冲突他们一家能否齐心协力，克服重重难关？

programme.title: 鬼同你住Coffin Homes

programme.title: 赏金猎人Bounty Hunters

programme.title: 美国女孩American Girl

programme.title: 靠近我一点.I Believe

Terpesona olehnya, dia tidak lama lagi terjerat dalam rangkaian misteri dan pembunuhannya. Ketika Adam diseret lebih jauh ke dalam dunia puak Iva dan Man menyelidiki penyiasatannya dengan lebih mendalam, mereka menemui mistik bawah tanah bomoh dan makhluk ghaib di bandar itu.

programme.title: Sweetpea EP3
programme.desc: Dengan kuasa dan kebenaran yang tinggi, Rhiannon mengejar sasaran seterusnya: pembuli tegar, Julia Blenkingsopp.

programme.title: Tiger Cage II
programme.desc: Selepas berada di tempat yang salah pada masa yang salah seorang bekas polis dan seorang peguam perceraian wanita menjadi buruan dan terpaksa bekerjasama dengan seorang penjenayah untuk membersihkan nama mereka daripada terlibat dalam skim pengubahan wang haram yang dipimpin oleh seorang peguam yang kejam.

programme.title: Hysteria! EP5
programme.desc: Insiden tragis menguatkan paranoia. Keluarga mula terheret dalam konflik yang semakin berbahaya.

programme.desc: Satu malam di pejabat bertukar menjadi mimpi ngeri apabila seorang wanita terperangkap dalam lif selepas gempa bumi besar.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP9
programme.desc: Memaparkan Lisa marahkan Syamil yang datang ke rumah Mbah Nira untuk berjumpanya. Syamil syak kumpulan lelaki yang meminta pertolongannya adalah perogol. Afifa meminta Lisa menghapuskan SakaSara. Mbah Nira marahkan mereka, namun selepas diketahui Sara adalah mangsa rogol dia merelakannya. Azhar dan Cairyl berpindah tinggal di hotel selepas diganggu oleh lembaga misteri yang kononnya dihantar oleh Mbah Nira semasa mereka berada di rumah Bakri. Nasrun insaf dan bersedia membongkar rahsia Kumpulan Hunter yang merogol gadis penduduk di kampungnya. Nasrun berjumpa dengan Syamil, dia bersedia memberi bukti bagi membantu Syamil menangkap Azhar dan Caryl. Manakala Lisa dan Afifa lebih berminat untuk membalas dendam secara sihir sebelum pihak berkuasa menangkap perogol mereka.

programme.title: Losmen Melati EP7
programme.desc: Melati, Golok, Sigit dan Ari bersiap sedia untuk melawan Kusno. Sara memasuki losmen mencari Fadil tetapi akhirnya terperangkap di salah satu bilik. Di sana, dia mendapati Fadil terperangkap dalam perigi dari episod 4. Diserang oleh roh rumah, Sara cuba menyelamatkan Fadil dan akhirnya mengorbankan dirinya dalam proses itu. Melati meyakinkan arwah rumah untuk berpihak kepadanya dalam perjuangannya menentang Kusno. Kusno dan Pemburu menyerang Losmen Melati. Sigit berbaik semula dengan Ari atas kengerian masa lalunya dan menentang ayahnya untuk kebaikan. Kini keluar dari perigi, Fadil cuba keluar dari rumah tetapi tersedut untuk melawan Kusno. Berjuang melawan Kusno sendiri, Fadil berada di ambang kematian apabila Kusno menggigitnya, membiarkan kutukan memasuki sistemnya. Apabila semua kelihatan hilang untuk Melati, dia mendedahkan senjata rahsianya - Watih, yang Kusno dipercayai telah mati, kembali untuk memberikan pukulan maut terakhir, akhirnya mengalahkan Kusno sekali dan untuk selama-lamanya. Namun apabila hari baru menjelma, Fadil muncul semula, tetapi semuanya tidak seperti yang disangka. Mata Fadil menjadi hitam, membayangkan kisah Losmen Melati belum berakhir.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP5
programme.desc: Memaparkan Pak Samad menerjah Nasrun kerana menyebabkan cucunya di rogol oleh Kumpulan Hunter. Perbualan mereka didengari oleh Lisa tentang kejadian rogol ke ats mereka 7 tahun lalu. Lisa mendapat profil perogol mereka dari Syamil, mereka sedang mengumpul bukti dan mahu Pak Samad menjadi saksi. Caryl tidak percaya yang penyakit Bakri disebabkan sihir ilmu hitam, sebaliknya Nasrun dan Azhar membawa Mbah Nira untuk mengubatinya. Namun Mbah Nira gagal memulihkannya. Satu malam, Azhar ternampak lembaga Bakri membunuh diri, sebaliknya Caryl syak Bakri mengambil dadah. Lisa menyerahkan profil perogol mereka kepada Afifa setelah mendapat maklumat dari Bayu, jam dihadiahkan oleh perogol kepadanya 7 tahun lalu sama seperti yang diterima oleh Bayu.

programme.title: Domino
programme.desc: Selepas bapanya, seorang ketua jenayah Vietnam yang berkuasa di Amerika Syarikat dibunuh secara kejam, tanpa diduga menjadi sasaran sindiket saingan. Terpaksa melangkah ke dunia berbahaya yang selalu dielakkannya.

programme.title: Nasi Tangas
programme.desc: Hairi dan Fatin adalah seorang kawan rapat. Mereka berdua bersama-sama membangunkan sebuah kafe yang dibuka bersama-sama. Hubungan mereka adalah seperti sepasang kekasih, tetapi Hairi dan Fatin tidak pernah lebih daripada seorang rakan. Mira juga rakan yang baik untuk Fatin. Mira mengakui bahawa dia jatuh cinta dengan Hairi.

programme.title: Perempuan Bergaun Merah
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata merompak bank dan menjadikan mereka yang berada dalam bank sebagai orang tebusan. Pihak polis berunding dan wanita tersebut bersetuju untuk melepaskan tebusan tanpa pihak polis mengetahui bahawa orang tebusan tersebut merupakan perompak dan rakan perompak itu sendiri.

programme.desc: Selepas sahabat baiknya hilang, seorang gadis kolej yang menghidap klaustrofobia mula menyiasat lif misteri tempat rakannya kali terakhir dilihat lif yang mungkin merupakan pintu ke dunia gelap yang menakutkan.

programme.desc: Imbas kembali beberapa tahun lalu semasa Lisa, Sara dan Afifa tinggal bersama Mbah Nira. Namun Sara mati, bagaimanapun Mbah Nira menggunakan ilmu hitamnya menjadikan Sara sebagai Saka. Mbah Nira menurunkan ilmu hitamnya kepada Lisa dan Afifa. Kali ini, Cairyl dan Azhar bertindak menculik Afifa dan Lisa, mereka mendesak Lisa dan Afifa supaya mengarahkan Mbah Nira membebaskan Bakri daripada terus disihirkan. Tiba-tiba muncul Saka Sara menyebabkan Cairyl dan Azhar melarikan diri. Lisa dan Afifa balik ke rumah Mbah Nira, diketahui ilmu hitam yang dimiliki oleh Lisa lebih kuat berbanding Afifa. Bakri akhirnya meninggal. Nasrun merayu pertolongan Syamil, meminta Mbah Nira melepaskannya daripada disihirkan. Lisa bertindak menggunakan Saka Sara ke atas Azhar dan Cairyl.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP6
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Bayu memberitahu Lisa, doktor Caryl yang menghadiahkan jam tersebut kepadanya. Jenama yang sama pernah dihadiahkan oleh Caryl kepadanya. Perkara tersebut dikongsikan oleh Lisa dengan Afifa. Mbah Nira minta Bakri dibawa ke rumahnya untuk diubati. Lisa terdengar perbulan Caryl dengan Azhar semasa berada di klinik, nama Bakri dan Nasrun disebut sebagai ahli kumpulan mereka. programme.desc: Citizens fighting for independence from Britain were met by an Army-quelled bloody riot that the government covered up. Over 100 Maltese were falsely jailed for instigating the violence.

programme.desc: Matt Damon returns as Jason Bourne in Jason Bourne, with director Paul Greengrass back for another thrilling chapter. Bourne is drawn out of hiding, facing new dangers with Alicia Vikander, Vincent Cassel, and more.

programme.desc: In Hellboy 2: The Golden Army, Hellboy faces a deadly army of creatures unleashed by a sinister villain. Directed by Guillermo del Toro, this action-packed sequel blends humor, heroism, and epic battles.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: Every district in the nation of Panem must send a boy and girl to fight to the death in the annual Hunger Games competition. Jennifer Lawrence is 16-year-old Katniss Everdeen, who volunteers to take her younger sisters place in the games.

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon
programme.desc: Mei Zhens family appears to get along but harbours deep secrets. Mei Zhen is trapped in a dead-end job with a toxic boss, her brother hides his separation and their mother grapples with lingering guilt over her husbands departure years ago. As Mid-Autumn Festival approaches, can the family heal their wounds and find a way back to each other?

programme.title: All U Need Is Love
programme.desc: Ten major film companies join forces on a comedy-drama film to raise funds and create jobs for industry workers during the COVID-19 pandemic. This film features an all-star ensemble cast starring for free, with the story revolving around a group of hotel guests placed under quarantine in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Panda Plan
programme.desc: After legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts the panda Hu Hu, an international crime syndicate places a massive bounty on the bear. Joined by his agent and Hu Hus caretaker, Jackie embarks on a daring quest to outsmart the villains.

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai becomes the prime suspect in a police murder case. He takes hostages at the police station and demands to negotiate with former negotiator Jun. As the two engage in a high-stake battle of wits, their expertise in psychological manipulation leads to a tense verbal sparring match, gradually shifting their positions and mind sets.

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping shocked China by coaching Team USA to victory against her home nation. Years later, when Chinas womens volleyball team fell into a slump, she returned to rebuild the squad and eventually led them to a historic gold medal triumph at the Rio 2016 Olympics.

programme.title: L Storm
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk and Chief Inspector Lau both hit a dead end when investigating their respective bribery and money laundering cases. When Luk is accused of bribery after being framed by the money launderers, he risks everything he has to find crucial evidence against them to clear his name.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career but Adam still wants to make up and tries to move her 77 times. Things become more complicated when a Thai movie idol courts Eva. It is at this time that Evas mother becomes very ill, and she considers marriage in order to fulfil her mothers wish. Will Adam succeed in warming Evas heart?

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer knows his father Wah is intellectually challenged since young and has to take care of him after his mother left them. When Mancer discovers and finds solace in stand-up comedy, he learns that hardships provide the best comedic material - from his own school ridicule experience to pandemic woes, misery can fuel laughter!

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: Veterinary assistant Zeming is pushed to the brink after a medical dispute. On the edge of life and death, he is drawn into a surreal realm of dreams and myth. Guided by a mysterious old man, he faces a brutal survival test, navigating illusion and reality in search of truth and awakening.

programme.title: Mamas Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A killer and a stage actor accidentally swapped their identities at a bathhouse. The actor must complete the killers mission while the killer thinks he is a hopeless actor after losing his memory during the accident. When the killer strives to become a successful stage actor, he also starts to recall what has happened

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Master Luo, a washed-up stuntman, trains his beloved horse Red Hare to be a stunt horse. Due to his debts though, Red Hare may be taken away by the debtors. Master Luo has no choice but to seek help from his estranged daughter, and the incident ends up becoming a golden opportunity for them to reconcile.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: In this comedy, three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists they have dinner at home every night as a family, but tensions begin to rise when their girlfriends join in as well. Love, friendship, jealousy and complicated relationships are all on the menu for this table for six!

programme.title: Song Of Spring
programme.desc: An 85-year-old mother lives with her 65-year-old daughter who is suffering from Alzheimers disease, causing her to suffer a decline in memory, mental confusion and disorientation. Though the elderly mother has to shoulder the burden of a caregiver, she still wants to be with her daughter forever.

programme.title: Untouchable
programme.desc: Zun Fei becomes the right-hand man to Macau tycoon Huang, whose hands are deep in both legal and illegal businesses. However, facing underworld violence, power struggles and moral dilemmas, Fei is torn between love and justice. Soon, he finds himself trapped in a deadly gamble set against him, with his life at stake.

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Xiao Fei is a cheerful girl who has been abandoned by her mother. One day, she encounters a gifted young man named Zi Wai, who is battling a rare disease. Determined to help him, she embarks on a journey to find his lost love. Even when they discover that the drug treating Wai is ineffective, they choose to embrace hope and love together.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into haunted flats, which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos.

programme.title: Man On The Edge
programme.desc: On the eve of the 1997 handover, violence is rampant with triad forces causing chaos in Hong Kong. The triad gang leader assigns his right-hand man Ah Lok to take charge of the drug trafficking business. However, Ah Lok turns out to be an undercover police officer who unveils a shocking political conspiracy during the investigation.

programme.title: The Wig
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a law graduate overwhelmed by despair after failing the bar exam three times and vents his frustration on a drunken passenger one stormy night. Twenty years later, Meng is a successful lawyer, but his investigation into a sexual assault case involving a young girl rekindles haunting memories he cannot escape.

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail.

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: On its maiden flight, an A380 airliner is hijacked by armed gunmen. Among the passengers is international security expert Gao Hao Jun, whose daughter has been taken hostage, putting her life in grave danger. Determined to save her, Gao confronts the hijackers head-on. Can he rescue all the passengers and thwart the crisis?

programme.title: The Lychee Road
programme.desc: A single lychee sparks a Tang Dynasty Mission Impossible! Low-ranking official Li Shan De must deliver it a thousand miles in three days to satisfy a consorts craving. Racing against time, he encounters obstacles and absurd demands, turning the journey into a satirical adventure filled with tension and unexpected twists.

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: This is based on a true story. A sudden earthquake hits the gas pipes in an industrial park, triggering massive explosions and engulfing the neighbouring area in flames. When the Fire Rescue Force reaches the scene, firefighters must fight against the flames and time, as they commit to safeguard lives with their own.

programme.desc: Abdullah meninggalkan keluarga bagi mencari rezeki di kota. Di Kota beliau dikenali sebagai Shawn, memperolehi kekayaan selepas melibatkan diri dengan gangterisma dan kelab malam. Shawn kemudiannya berjumpa dengan seorang ustaz meminta nasihat, dia akhirnya meninggalkan keluarganya dan menghilangkan diri.

programme.title: Religious Clip

programme.title: Asbab Al Nuzul
programme.desc: Episod ini akan menerangkan surah al-Maun. Asbab Al Nuzul yang akan menjelaskan persoalan-persoalan yang menyebabkan turunnya satu-satu ayat atau beberapa ayat untuk menerangkan peristiwa dan hukumnya turunnya ayat Al- Quran. Ia berkaitan dengan beberapa ayat untuk menerangkan hal yang berhubungan dengan peristiwa tertentu atau memberikan jawapan tertentu dalam bahagian dari ilmu tafsir Quran.

programme.title: Oh! My Prince
programme.desc: Keberanian dan kejujuran Danial sedikit sebanyak menyentuh hati Adlina. Danial tidak putus asa untuk memenangi hati Adlina sekalipun Adlina sudah menyatakan dia menyintai Hairi sepenuh hati. Adlina marah apabila Danial menghantar gambar mereka berdua! Cuti semester itu Hadi, abang Adlina mahu Adlina pulang ke kampung. Memandangkan Hairi bercuti bersama keluarganya ke Turki, Adlina tidak punya pilihan selain dari pulang juga.

programme.title: Sunnah Nabi
programme.desc: Episod kali ini bersama Ustaz Tajid membawa topik Kepimpinan Masyarakat Hubungan Jiran dengan panel Ustaz Hassan Adli. Sunnah Nabi merupakan program keagamaan yang membawakan perbincangan santai namun ilmiah mengenai amalan sunnah dalam kehidupan seharian umat Islam. Program ini menampilkan pelbagai topik umum dan khusus berkaitan sunnah.

programme.title: Religious Clip

programme.title: Alhamdulillah

programme.title: Ali Alia
programme.desc: Ali dan Alia merupakan pasangan kembar yang sangat rapat sejak kecil. Namun kehidupan mereka mula berubah apabila kedua ibu bapa mereka terlalu sibuk bekerja hingga menyebabkan mereka berasa terabai, terutama Alia yang menghidap autisme.

programme.title: Deko Ibadah

Deko Ibadah berkongsi inspirasi menghias dan menyusun ruang ibadah yang selesa, praktikal serta menenangkan. Menggabungkan elemen dekorasi dan pengisian Islam, program ini membantu mewujudkan persekitaran yang lebih kondusif untuk beribadah dan menghayati nilai-nilai murni.

programme.title: Jom Jalan
programme.desc: Jom Jalan akan membawa Selebriti tanah air ke serata pelusuk tanah air. Pada setiap episod Selebriti akan membawa penonton ke destinasi menarik yang meliputi lokasi percutian, lokasi bersejarah, membeli belah dan makanan tempatan. Pada minggu ni Jom Jalan membawa penonton ke negeri Negeri Sembilan.

programme.title: Jom Fesyen
programme.desc: Jom Fesyen merupakan program berteraskan kepada pamakaian wanita Muslimah. Jom Fesyen membawa penonton mengenali, menyaksikan kreativiti pereka tempatan yang menghasilkan busana Muslimah di pasaran.

programme.title: Alhamdulillah
programme.desc: Episod Alhamdulillah kali ini bersama Dato Alha Alfa yang akan merungkai rahsia di sebalik kejayaan personaliti yang berjaya di Malaysia bagaimana permulaan kehidupan mereka untuk hidup dan kisah kejayaan seseorang usahawan dalam bidang yang diusahakan.

programme.title: Umar Hatta
programme.desc: Ketika Leyla sedang menangis sendirian di lobi hospital, dia telah berkenalan dengan Nadia, wanita muslimah yang menarik Leyla kembali ke jalan yang lurus lagi benar. Dengan mengingat Tuhan, Leyla mula menemui ketenangan. Dia juga mampu mengawal diri dan melupakan kekhilafan suaminya, malah berusaha memujuk Hatta agar bertaubat. programme.title: Assalamualaikum Subuh L
programme.desc: Program bual bicara keagamaanmengupas topik berkaitan dengan menghidupkan ibadah di waktu Subuh bagi meraih keberkatan dari Allah SWT.

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati
programme.desc: Datin Sharifah ialah seorang balu yang mempunyai dua orang anak remaja, Shah dan Ina. Shah mempunyai seorang teman wanita berbangsa Cina yang bernama Linda dan Ina pula bercinta dengan Johari. Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.

programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.

programme.title: Suci Dalam Debu
programme.desc: Roy, seorang anak kaya yang ingin berkawan dengan pemuzik bertemu Rina di sebuah kelab malam. Namun, Rina telah ditunangkan dengan Tengku Johan oleh bapanya, Tengku Aziz. Tengku Johan ingin mempercepatkan tarikh perkahwinan mereka kerana ingin memiliki Rina. Roy telah dicabar dan diletakkan taruhan oleh Tengku Johan jika benar dia boleh mendapatkan Rina.

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.

programme.title: Sindrom Mana Anakku
programme.desc: Dr. Kamal dan Dr. Lisa bekerja di hospital yang sama. Dr. Kamal keluar mendapat panggilan kecemasan di sebuah rumah. Dibawa pesakit tersebut ke hospital kerana kemungkinan komplikasi kelahiran namun mula tertanya-tanya di manakah anaknya. Anak pesakit tersebut perlu dicari sebelum apa-apa berlaku kepadanya.

programme.title: Bayangan Cinta
programme.desc: Pertemuan dua bekas kekasih, Auzy dan Akhbar selepas 18 tahun membangkitkan perasaan lama. Walau perasaan cinta masih kuat, hubungan mereka tidak dapat diteruskan kerana Akhbar sudah pun berkahwin. Suratan takdir mengatakan sebaliknya apabila Auzy kini mengajar anak kepada Akhbar, Andy.

programme.title: Si Luncai
programme.desc: Cinta ditolak kerana pangkat dan darjat, Si Luncai, sang pengembala kambing pergi dengan harapan yang hancur. Dirinya yang lurus dipermainkan oleh Ketua Kampung - namun kejadian tersebut telah membawanya ke seorang nenek kebayan yang telah mengubah hidupnya. Si Luncai menyamar menjadi tukang tabib dan mempermainkan semula Ketua Kampung itu. Berjayakah rancangan Si Luncai untuk mendapatkan cintanya?

programme.title: Manis Manis Sayang
programme.desc: Terkesan dengan tingkah laku Bahadom terhadapnya di khalayak ramai, Jalil membuat keputusan untuk berhenti bekerja. Namun Bahadom mempunyai rancangan lain apabila Datuk menyuruhnya untuk mencari seorang pegawai untuk dihantar ke luar negara. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.

programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Operasi Cegah Jenayah
programme.desc: Dua orang anggota polis, Shah dan Din telah ditugaskan untuk mengawasi satu pertunjukan permata berlian yang bernilai jutaan ringgit. Pihak penganjur juga meminta mereka berdua menjaga para peragawati mereka yang sedang bercuti daripada pertunjukan itu. Dalam masa yang sama, Crystal yang menjadi pengurus agensi peragawati itu merancang satu rompakan barangan berharga yang berada dalam pengawasan Shah dan Din.

Namun Bahadom mempunyai rancangan lain apabila Datuk menyuruhnya untuk mencari seorang pegawai untuk dihantar ke luar negara. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.

programme.title: Suara Kekasih

Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati

Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.

programme.desc: Rizal, seorang bekas banduan yang baru dibebaskan dari penjara. Dengan perasaan yang cekal untuk buktikan dia seorang yang masih berguna kepada masyarakat dia kuatkan semangat untuk pulang ke kampung semula lalu membuka sebuah kedai makan.

programme.title: Sifu Tongga
programme.desc: Dua lelaki dengan personaliti dan cara hidup yang sangat berbeza secara tidak sengaja terlibat dalam pelbagai situasi huru-hara. Walaupun sering bergaduh dan tidak sehaluan, mereka terpaksa bekerjasama untuk menyelesaikan masalah yang membawa mereka ke dalam dunia penuh aksi, kekacauan dan komedi yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: Dilan 1990
programme.desc: Cerita cinta remaja antara Dilan, seorang pelajar yang unik dan romantik, dengan Milea, pelajar baru yang berpindah ke Bandung pada tahun 1990. Cara Dilan yang berbeza dalam mendekati Milea membuatkan hubungan mereka berkembang, tetapi mereka juga perlu menghadapi cabaran persahabatan, sekolah dan kehidupan remaja.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Dilan 1991
programme.desc: Sambungan kisah cinta Dilan dan Milea selepas mereka menjadi pasangan. Hubungan mereka mula diuji apabila Dilan semakin terlibat dengan geng motor dan pergaduhan di sekolah, menyebabkan Milea risau dan hubungan mereka menjadi tegang. Milea terpaksa membuat keputusan yang sukar demi masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Kasih Seorang Ayah
programme.desc: Husin yang baru memulakan pekerjaan baharu dikejutkan oleh panggilan isterinya, Aminahayahnya, Pak Yusof, tidak pulang sejak keluar pagi tadi. Setelah mencari ke merata tempat, Husin akhirnya menemui Pak Yusof di sebuah perhentian bas dalam keadaan keliru dan ketakutan. Pak Yusof tidak ingat jalan pulang, malah tidak tahu di mana dia berada. Hairan dengan perubahan sikap ayahnya, Husin membawa beliau ke klinik. Di situlah mereka menerima berita yang mengejutkan: Pak Yusof menghidap Alzheimer. Dari saat itu, bermulalah perjalanan penuh cabaran buat Husin dan keluarganya dalam menjaga insan yang mereka sayangi.

programme.title: Jika Fattah
programme.desc: Kehadiran Fattah yang merupakan seorang anak yatim di dalam keluarga Zaidi telah mengubah kehidupan mereka sekeluarga melalui sikap terpuji yang ada di dalam diri Fattah yang menyedarkan Zaidi dan isterinya Intan.

programme.title: Salina
programme.desc: Salina tinggal di sebuah banglo cantik yang mempunyai sejarah misteri. Apabila kejadian aneh dan menakutkan mula berlaku, terutamanya terhadap anak-anaknya, Salina mula menyiasat sejarah banglo itu untuk melindungi mereka. Namun, keadaan menjadi semakin teruk sehingga membawa kepada kematian yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: Taikun
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua lelaki bernama Tai dan Kun, sahabat baik yang hanya meminati pergaduhan dan mencuri. Apabila tabiat buruk mereka menyebabkan mereka bertembung dan memukul teruk ahli geng Pink dan Purple, Tai dan Kun kemudian direkrut oleh ketua geng yang kagum dengan kemahiran mereka.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Olimpias Way
programme.desc: Seorang penyanyi pop berusia 70 tahun yang pernah menjadi legenda muzik memulakan satu perjalanan merentasi tempat-tempat yang pernah menaikkan namanya. Dia menyewa seorang gadis muda yang pemalu sebagai pemandu, dan bersama-sama mereka melalui perjalanan emosi yang penuh kenangan, perubahan diri, dan hubungan antara dua generasi. Sepanjang perjalanan itu, mereka mula memahami erti kehidupan, kehilangan, dan kebebasan untuk memilih jalan sendiri.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Zharfa
programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan Zharfa, seorang gadis Malaysia yang penuh pemberontakan dan emosional, sejak ditinggalkan oleh ayah kandungnya ketika berusia satu tahun. Selepas ibunya berkahwin dengan lelaki licik, konflik antara Zharfa dan bapa tirinya semakin memuncak. Akhirnya, dia dihantar ke sebuah pesantren di pedalaman Jawa Barat, Indonesia, di mana wataknya terus berkembang dalam latar budaya dan agama yang kuat

programme.title: Prebet Sapu
programme.desc: Pada 2018, Aman berpindah dari Pahang ke Kuala Lumpur mengejar impian menjadi penulis, namun hidupnya penuh kesusahandihalau dari bilik sewa, terpaksa tidur di kereta, dan menjadi pemandu e-hailing secara haram kerana buta warna. Hidupnya berubah apabila bertemu Bella, seorang penumpang yang menawarkan tempat tinggal dengan syarat Aman menjadi pemandu peribadinya. Persahabatan terjalin, tetapi konflik menanti. Bagaimana nasib kedua-dua jiwa miskin bandar ini akan terungkai?

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Suster El
programme.desc: Kisah seorang gadis yatim piatu bernama Elnara yang tinggal bersama kakaknya, Resti. Demi memenuhi impian Nara untuk menjadi jururawat, Resti bekerja keras. Hingga suatu hari, Resti bertemu dengan seorang lelaki kaya bernama Verdi dan mereka akhirnya menikah. Nara sangat gembira kerana perkahwinan Resti membawa kehidupan yang lebih baik untuk mereka, tetapi kegembiraan Nara berakhir seketika apabila dia menemui sesuatu yang menggoncangkan dunianya dan mengancam untuk memisahkan keluarganya.

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Hatiku Tercipta Untukmu
programme.desc: Zaki Ridho Illahi, seorang ejen hartanah, gigih bekerja demi menyara dua adiknya walaupun sering berdepan masalah kewangan. Hidupnya mula berubah selepas bertemu Alisa Shanice Margaretha, namun kebahagiaan mereka diuji apabila Yudi Adhitya Alkatiri, sahabat yang juga saudara tirinya, berusaha menghancurkan segala yang dimiliki Zaki.

programme.title: Saleha
programme.desc: Saleha mengisahkan seorang gadis baik hati yang ditinggalkan oleh ayahnya dan dibesarkan oleh nenek. Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.title: Foodie Buddy
programme.desc: Program masakan dan kulinari yang meneroka keunikan serta kekayaan cita rasa hidangan Indonesia, menampilkan pelbagai sajian tradisional, ramuan tempatan dan pengalaman kulinari dari seluruh negara.

programme.title: Rindu Bukan Rindu
programme.desc: Rindu Bukan Rindu mengisahkan kisah seorang wanita bernama Rindu yang merasa bertuah memiliki seorang lelaki bernama Devan. Kedua-duanya tinggal di Jepun dan menghabiskan masa bersama. Devan sentiasa berada di dekat Rindu, melindungi dan mencintainya. Hubungan di antara mereka terasa sangat rapat dan sempurna. Tetapi suatu hari, Rindu melihat Devan memegang tangan seorang wanita lain. Apakah yang terjadi di antara mereka?

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: DAcademy 7
programme.desc: D Academy 7 ialah musim ketujuh rancangan nyanyian popular Indonesia yang fokus pada muzik dangdut. Peserta dari seluruh negara bertanding dengan menyanyikan lagu dangdut, menunjukkan bakat vokal dan persembahan mereka. Sepanjang musim, mereka dinilai oleh juri profesional dan undian penonton. Siapakah yang akan menjuarai DAcademy musim ketujuh?

programme.title: Hi Guys
programme.desc: Sebuah siri separa dokumentari yang menyeronokkan dan dikendalikan oleh sekumpulan hos cilik yang penuh tenaga. Mereka meneroka pelbagai tempat menarik dan aktiviti yang mengujakan, sambil berkongsi pengalaman dengan semangat ingin tahu dan keceriaan. Setiap episod membawa penonton mengikuti perjalanan yang dipenuhi tawa dan penemuan baharu, sambil menggalakkan kanak-kanak untuk belajar serta mengenali dunia di sekeliling mereka dengan cara yang menyeronokkan dan menarik.

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Hatiku Tercipta Untukmu

programme.title: Doyan Makan

programme.title: Qari Cilik Season 3
programme.desc: Qari Cilik Indonesia kembali untuk musim ketiga, menampilkan kanak-kanak berbakat dalam seni tilawah Al-Quran. Saksikan perjalanan para peserta muda dalam menyampaikan bacaan yang indah dan penuh makna.

Kedua-duanya tinggal di Jepun dan menghabiskan masa bersama. Devan sentiasa berada di dekat Rindu, melindungi dan mencintainya. Hubungan di antara mereka terasa sangat rapat dan sempurna. Tetapi suatu hari, Rindu melihat Devan memegang tangan seorang wanita lain. Apakah yang terjadi di antara mereka?

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: DAcademy 7
programme.desc: D Academy 7 ialah musim ketujuh rancangan nyanyian popular Indonesia yang fokus pada muzik dangdut. Peserta dari seluruh negara bertanding dengan menyanyikan lagu dangdut, menunjukkan bakat vokal dan persembahan mereka. Sepanjang musim, mereka dinilai oleh juri profesional dan undian penonton. Siapakah yang akan menjuarai DAcademy musim ketujuh?

programme.title: Qari Cilik Season 3
programme.desc: Qari Cilik Indonesia kembali untuk musim ketiga, menampilkan kanak-kanak berbakat dalam seni tilawah Al-Quran. Saksikan perjalanan para peserta muda dalam menyampaikan bacaan yang indah dan penuh makna.

programme.title: Gak Pengen Jadi Ipar Pengennya Jadi Pacar
programme.desc: Wini Indah Nicole tiba-tiba dia menabrak seorang laki-laki ban sepedanya menyentuh bagian vital laki-laki tersebut. Wini harus berurusan dengan Dito Hardi Fadhillah yang merasa dirugikan untuk masa depannya. Suatu ketika, Wini mempertemukan adiknya dengan Dito dan memaksa untuk menikah. Namun anehnya, hati kecil Indah menolak, sebenarnya dia itu menyukai laki-laki yang dia jodohkan dengan adiknya

programme.title: Mega Series Suara Hati Istri: Anjani
programme.desc: Anjani berkahwin dengan Ammar melalui perkahwinan yang diatur, namun malangnya Ammar tidak mencintai Anjani, terutamanya selepas mengetahui bahawa Anjani sukar untuk hamil. Akhirnya, Anjani mengambil anak angkat yang ternyata mempunyai rahsia masa lalu dalam kehidupan suaminya.

programme.title: Doyan Makan
programme.desc: Doyan Makan menjemput penonton untuk mengikuti perjalanan dan pengalaman kulinari untuk makanan popular di kawasan tersebut, serta akan meninjau informasi tentang tempat, harga dan proses penghasilan makanan yang mereka nikmati.

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.

With so much surrounding information, the show features a special Fact Check segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. Cantopop At 50 invites original singers or accomplished vocalists to reinterpret these once-popular classics that transcend generations, delivering high-quality musical enjoyment to music lovers. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: Finance Magazine 2026
programme.desc: Financial Insights keeps a close watch on the market, reviewing weekly trends in Hong Kong stocks and paying attention to the real estate sector. Through exclusive interviews with industry professionals and market analysis, the program explores popular local and international finance topics in a clear and accessible manner. It also features in-depth reports on the challenges faced by different industries as they develop.

The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry

programme.title: Lo And Behold
programme.desc: HUNG SHU-KAN Lau Dan built his own logistics business from scratch and now everything is in order. The only thing on his mind is the well-being of his three daughters. His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, HUNG YUEK-SHUI Koni Lui, is still single. She and her little prodigy sister, HUNG SUM-YUE Andrea So, often fight over small things, putting their father in dilemmas.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Severe Case Decoded
programme.desc: The program focuses on various serious illnesses, explaining their causes, pathological mechanisms, latest treatment options, and prevention methods in an accessible way. Shaun Tam, Hera Chan, ,Kirby Lam and Carina Leung become investigators in the Critical Care Unit, searching far and wide for clues, evidence, and witnesses to unravel the mysteries surrounding various deadly diseases. Senior doctors and scholars from major public and private hospitals in Hong Kong, as well as local university medical schools, combine real case studies and medical images to make complex medical knowledge relatable, enabling the public to gain a more comprehensive understanding of the diagnosis and treatment of serious illnesses, reducing misunderstandings and fear, and encouraging Hong Kong residents to get early checkups and timely treatment to safeguard their future health.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Walking With You
programme.desc: Sharon Chan, Samantha Ko, Katy Kung, and Grace Chan are close friends in the entertainment industry. This trip to Malaysia was a rare girls getaway, filled with delicious food, fun activities, and experiencing the local culture. During the trip, the four beautiful hosts each invited their friends Lai Lok-yi, Mat Yeung, and Ma Kwun-tung to join them, traveling to Selangor, Pahang, Terengganu, Kelantan, and Sabah. programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry

programme.title: Scam Alert!
programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. It is reported that Hong Kong suffers an average daily loss of HK25 million, with a scam occurring every 13 minutes Scams targeting online shopping, job seeking, investment, dating apps, and telephone scams are becoming increasingly sophisticated. Citizens must raise their awareness of scams and be vigilant to avoid falling victim! Hosts Au Wing-Kuen, Edwin Siu, Lee Man-Fong, and Leung Man-Hau gather various real-life cases to gain a deeper understanding of how victims were scammed. The program will also recreate these scenarios in story form. Experts will appear to dissect different methods of committing these crimes, helping viewers identify money-grabbing traps and avoid becoming targets of scammers!

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Scam Alert!
programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. It is reported that Hong Kong suffers an average daily loss of HK25 million, with a scam occurring every 13 minutes Scams targeting online shopping, job seeking, investment, dating apps, and telephone scams are becoming increasingly sophisticated. Citizens must raise their awareness of scams and be vigilant to avoid falling victim! Hosts Au Wing-Kuen, Edwin Siu, Lee Man-Fong, and Leung Man-Hau gather various real-life cases to gain a deeper understanding of how victims were scammed. The program will also recreate these scenarios in story form. Experts will appear to dissect different methods of committing these crimes, helping viewers identify money-grabbing traps and avoid becoming targets of scammers!

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show. Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Just Eat
programme.desc: In the new culinary show Just Eat, celebrities reveal their favorite chefs and memorable dishes. This series explores how these culinary experiences have impacted their lives, from overcoming personal struggles to finding new career paths. Join us to discover the flavors and stories that resonate with these well-known personalities.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.
